cases.title: Upload a two-party NDA and get a full proposal
preconditions: Document nda_two_party is on your computer
steps: Go to the Inbox
Click "Upload new PDF" and choose nda_two_party
Watch the progress text while it works
Wait for the Review screen to open
expected: Progress text changes from "Uploading…" to "Reading the document and finding blanks…" to "Finding signers and fields with AI…"
Review opens within about 60 seconds, with the file name and document type at the top
The drop bar shows "Needs review", one chip per signer (two here) and "Not a field"
Each signer's section holds that party's signature, name, title and date fields
Boxes on the page preview sit on the document's blank lines
A new line was added to backend/out/llm_calls.jsonl with tokens and cost
cases.notes: The AI can vary slightly between runs; judge the proposal, not exact counts.

cases.title: Signature blocks stay together
steps: Click a signer's section title (e.g. "Signer for …") to highlight all of their boxes
Check the highlighted boxes on the page preview
expected: Only one party's block is highlighted: its signature, printed name, title and date
No field from the other party's block is highlighted

cases.title: The AI explains what it rejected
steps: Click the "Not a field" chip in the drop bar
Read each card in the "Not a field" section
expected: Each card shows a reason (e.g. table border, underlined heading)
If the section is empty, that's fine: it says "Nothing here."

cases.title: Radio choices, checkbox and preamble blanks are understood
preconditions: Document services_choices is on your computer
steps: Go to the Inbox
Click "Upload new PDF" and choose services_choices
Wait for Review to open
Find a card whose type is "Radio option"
expected: Each round option is its own "Radio option" card showing "Option N of M"
All options of one question belong to the same person
The tick box is a "Checkbox" card
Blanks about the agreement itself (e.g. fee, effective date) are in "Needs review" or with a likely signer, each with a reason

cases.title: Scanned document
preconditions: Document scanned is on your computer
steps: Click "Upload new PDF" and choose the scanned document
Wait for Review to open
Expand "AI summary & questions" if it is minimised
expected: Fields are proposed on the scanned page's lines
The AI summary notes that the page is scanned and read from the image
Anything uncertain is in "Needs review" with a reason

cases.title: Document with existing form fields
preconditions: Document form_fields is on your computer
steps: Click "Upload new PDF" and choose form_fields
Wait for Review to open
expected: The PDF's own form fields become boxes in exactly the same place
Its radio buttons are grouped into choices; its checkboxes are checkboxes

cases.title: Document with no blanks
preconditions: Document no_blanks is on your computer
steps: Click "Upload new PDF" and choose no_blanks
Wait for Review to open
Read the AI summary
expected: No fields are invented
The AI summary says no blanks were found and fields need to be added by hand
"+ Add field" still works
